description: dev-pipeline commit gate — config-aware type-check before any git commit (fires only when the consumer repo has onboarded a typecheck command; fails open otherwise). Two matchers: `git commit *`, and `git -c * commit *` for a bot-identity commit typed inline, as design-faithful does. With a bot configured, lane commits go through bot-commit.sh by its path and match neither; without one, a lane commit is a plain `git commit` and matches the first.
